issues.issue: Completeness: The content is truncated at the end of the 'Incident Response' table row.

issues.issue: Factual Accuracy: Unsubstantiated statistic regarding '60% reduction in MTTD'.

issues.suggestion: Explicitly reference specific regional compliance frameworks relevant to the Dubai/MEA market, such as the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) or Saudi Arabia's NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) controls, to demonstrate local expertise.
